# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_journal_map_scales.py — do not edit manually.
# The Map Room's maps fitted to the world (te_journal_map_scales_generated.txt): each te_jmap_range_<map>
# measures the world's range for a map, from the 5th lowest to the 5th highest of the states it
# paints with a figure (the lowest and highest where fewer have one; the fixed curve's ends where none has),
# into te_jmap_rng_<map>_lo / _hi. Any scope: ordered_state iterates the world's states. te_jmap_refresh_range
# measures the pick's map (te_jmap_set_selector, te_journal_map_effects.txt; and monthly,
# te_journal_map_on_actions.txt), te_jmap_refresh_entry_ranges the maps a system's own entry draws too.

# Turmoil, the radicals' share: half the color by a fifth of the world's range, the rest more slowly.
te_jmap_range_turmoil = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi }
		remove_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi
	}
	ordered_state = {
		order_by = te_jmap_turmoil_input
		position = 4
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi value = te_jmap_turmoil_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		order_by = te_jmap_turmoil_input_neg
		position = 4
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo value = te_jmap_turmoil_input }
	}
	# Fewer states than the trim takes out: the extremes.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi } }
		ordered_state = {
			order_by = te_jmap_turmoil_input
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_hi value = te_jmap_turmoil_input }
		}
		ordered_state = {
			order_by = te_jmap_turmoil_input_neg
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_turmoil_lo value = te_jmap_turmoil_input }

	}
}

	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_old_share has_variable = te_dg_median var:te_dg_median > 0 }
		order_by = te_jmap_old_input
		position = 4
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_old_hi value = te_jmap_old_input }
	}
	ordered_state = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_old_share has_variable = te_dg_median var:te_dg_median > 0 }
		order_by = te_jmap_old_input_neg
		position = 4
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_old_lo value = te_jmap_old_input }
	}
	# Fewer states than the trim takes out: the extremes.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_old_hi } }
		ordered_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_old_share has_variable = te_dg_median var:te_dg_median > 0 }
			order_by = te_jmap_old_input
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_old_hi value = te_jmap_old_input }
		}
		ordered_state = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_old_share has_variable = te_dg_median var:te_dg_median > 0 }
			order_by = te_jmap_old_input_neg
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			set_global_variable = { name = te_jmap_rng_old_lo value = te_jmap_old_input }
		}
	}
}

# The pick's map, if it is fitted to the world (te_jmap_selector, te_journal_map_values.txt).
te_jmap_refresh_range = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 1 }
		te_jmap_range_turmoil = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_selector = 3 }
		te_jmap_range_e0 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
